definition.label: Recipe profile points
definition.description: Read up to four exact profile points for an existing lathe or extrude part at a fixed object revision. For lathe, x is radius, y is height and segments is the angular subdivision count. For extrude, x/y are the normalized XY outline and segments is zero; thickness is part.size.z. vertices is a conservative generated vertex cost for the whole recipe; the room limit is 262144. Offset equal to count returns an empty page. Missing/non-profile parts, stale revisions and later offsets are unavailable. The profile is geometry, not a fluid container or a hollow collider.
